g.text: Everything except vyrn.slice is fenced onto one housekeeping core
06 §4.6 · cgroup v2, managed by systemd · REF box: HK = core 51
vyrn.slice may use every core; each thread then pins itself
to exactly one, from its core map (sched_setaffinity)
starts on core 51 unless its slice allows more
scheduled on the other cores. No cpuset
